title: Conditional current-city breathing and heuristic health score
description: Packaged recurrent CVAE with explicit current-city proxy inputs, bounded donor estimates and explicit covariate template.

assumed_background_pm25_ug_m3.description: Assumed PM2.5 background from the original local scenario; not observed current city background.

pmx_to_pm25_proxy_fraction.description: Experimental fraction of city exhaust PMx assigned to a PM2.5 proxy; not a calibrated size conversion.

max_temperature_fill_m.description: Maximum route-position to valid cell-centre distance for an explicitly estimated air temperature.

max_pmx_fill_m.description: Maximum route-position to valid cell-centre distance for an explicitly estimated PMx increment.

solar_warming_c_per_800.description: Original heuristic solar warming at 800 W/m2; does not replace air temperature in CVAE.

breathing_history_offset_s.description: Offset into the retained historical private physiology template, independent of city observation time.

followup_until_elapsed_s.description: Optional assumed stationary follow-up at the recorded destination; never repeats city fields.
